{{Top|leg}}
The '''Alliance Forces''' were the branch of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic's]] [[Alliance Military/Legends|military]] that was under the direct command of [[Alliance High Command/Legends|Alliance High Command]]. The main bulk of the Alliance Forces was the [[Alliance Fleet/Legends|Alliance Fleet]] and attendant [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadrons]], support services, and a small but effective cadre of ground forces. Units in the Alliance Forces were intended to respond to strategic opportunities and counter dangerous [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] threats. The counterpart to the Alliance Forces were the [[Sector Force/Legends|Sector Forces]], semi-autonomous military units responsible for operations throughout an assigned [[Sector/Legends|sector]].
